# SplitRGBA

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Split a color into its red, green, blue, and alpha components (range 0-255).
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/split-rgba",
  "type": "SplitRGBAOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/split-rgba').par.color` (an input) and `op('/split-rgba').out.r` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.color`, `out.r`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `color` | `ColorField` | `{"accessor":true}` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `r` | `NumberField` |
| `g` | `NumberField` |
| `b` | `NumberField` |
| `a` | `NumberField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
